propositions: Five test modules repeatedly construct equivalent virgin git-backed rebar topologies from scratch for every test consumer, consuming 103.416 aggregate worker-seconds across 260 fixture_setup spans in Gerrit Verify run 31846417650.

Runtime probes measured real git/rebar topology construction versus isolated per-test copies at approximate speedup ratios of 12x, 17.7x, 23x, 13.8x, and 15.7x, proving the repeated work is invariant setup rather than test-body logic.

The clone_topology_template helper initially copied .opcert-key and .pub verbatim across cloned topologies instead of reminting them per-environment, violating the isolation contract that per-test copies cannot share signing keys.

Session-scoped template plus per-test copy patterns are used by Django setUpTestData, Rails fixtures, GitLab let_it_be, and pytest tmp_path_factory, with no documented rejections for coverage/reliability; prior ticket peculiar-calmy-bubblefish accepted this pattern and measured 31% wall-time reduction.

The fix adds session-scoped template construction, per-test isolated topology copies with path/identity reminting, and isolation sentinels that verify shared refs, signing state, worktree pointers, and object stores are not leaked across tests.

All 125 affected tests passed; the exact local default selector passed 13,441 tests and integration selector passed 167 tests; targeted >1s fixture_setup spans from the five migrated modules disappeared without removing, skipping, or weakening any behavioral assertion.
